# username and bcrypt hash come from the vault item "alertmanager prometheus (hub)".

  fixture-user-3: "fixture-bcrypt-3"
roles/hub/templates/gatus-config.yaml.j2:
# Managed by Ansible (roles/hub). Edits here are overwritten.
metrics: true

storage:
  type: sqlite
  path: /data/data.db


alerting:
  ntfy:
    url: "https://ntfy.tail4cf2f3.ts.net"
    topic: pages
    token: "fixture-token-7"
    priority: 5
    default-alert:
      failure-threshold: 2
      send-on-resolved: true

endpoints:
  - name: ntfy
    group: hub
    url: "https://ntfy.tail4cf2f3.ts.net/v1/health"
    interval: 1m
    conditions:
      - "[STATUS] == 200"
      - "[BODY].healthy == true"
      - "[CERTIFICATE_EXPIRATION] > 336h"
    # Alert when ntfy's certificate nears expiry.
    alerts:
      - type: ntfy

  - name: grafana
    group: hub
    url: "https://grafana.tail4cf2f3.ts.net/api/health"
    interval: 1m
    conditions:
      - "[STATUS] == 200"
      - "[BODY].database == ok"
      - "[CERTIFICATE_EXPIRATION] > 336h"
    alerts:
      - type: ntfy

  # OpenBao answers 200 only when initialized, unsealed and active. This check has no Gatus alert:
  # its notice is the OpenBaoUnhealthy rule in prometheus-rules.yml, which Alertmanager's
  # band_health route sends straight to ntfy's tickets topic (OpenBao on the hub decision 59).
  - name: openbao
    group: hub
    url: "https://openbao.tail4cf2f3.ts.net/v1/sys/health"
    interval: 1m
    conditions:
      - "[STATUS] == 200"
    extra-labels:
      certificate_ticket: "true"

  - name: apex
    group: site
    url: "https://keepbreath.ing/"
    interval: 2m
    conditions:
      - "[STATUS] == 200"
      - "[CERTIFICATE_EXPIRATION] > 336h"
    alerts:
      - type: ntfy

  - name: www
    group: site
    url: "https://www.keepbreath.ing/"
    interval: 2m
    conditions:
      - "[STATUS] == 200"
      - "[CERTIFICATE_EXPIRATION] > 336h"
    alerts:
      - type: ntfy

  - name: domain-expiration
    group: site
    url: "https://keepbreath.ing/"
    interval: 24h
    conditions:
      - "[DOMAIN_EXPIRATION] > 720h"
    alerts:
      - type: ntfy

  - name: contact-form
    group: site
    url: "https://keepbreath.ing/api/challenge"
    interval: 2m
    conditions:
      - "[STATUS] == 200"
      - "len([BODY].signature) > 0"
    alerts:
      - type: ntfy

  - name: mail-submission
    group: mail
    url: "starttls://mail.keepbreath.ing:587"
    interval: 15m
    conditions:
      - "[CONNECTED] == true"
      - "[CERTIFICATE_EXPIRATION] > 336h"
    alerts:
      - type: ntfy

  - name: password-vault
    group: vault
    url: "https://vault.tail4cf2f3.ts.net/alive"
    interval: 2m
    conditions:
      - "[STATUS] == 200"
      - "[CERTIFICATE_EXPIRATION] > 336h"
    alerts:
      - type: ntfy

  - name: last-deploy
    group: github
    url: "https://api.github.com/repos/sh4i-yurei/keepbreathing/actions/workflows/deploy.yml/runs?status=completed&per_page=1"
    interval: 5m
    headers:
      Authorization: "Bearer fixture-password-8"
      Accept: application/vnd.github+json
    conditions:
      - "[STATUS] == 200"
      - "[BODY].workflow_runs[0].conclusion == success"
    alerts:
      - type: ntfy

  - name: deploy-queue
    group: github
    url: "https://api.github.com/repos/sh4i-yurei/keepbreathing/actions/workflows/deploy.yml/runs?status=queued&per_page=1"
    interval: 5m
    headers:
      Authorization: "Bearer fixture-password-8"
      Accept: application/vnd.github+json
    conditions:
      - "[STATUS] == 200"
      - "[BODY].total_count == 0"
    alerts:
      - type: ntfy
        failure-threshold: 3

  - name: runner
    group: github
    url: "https://api.github.com/repos/sh4i-yurei/keepbreathing/actions/runners"
    interval: 5m
    headers:
      Authorization: "Bearer fixture-password-8"
      Accept: application/vnd.github+json
    conditions:
      - "[STATUS] == 200"
      - "[BODY].runners[0].status == online"
    alerts:
      - type: ntfy
# Managed by Ansible (roles/hub). Edits here are overwritten.
# Grafana's data sources (Monitoring and alerting decisions #16, #39 and #41). Grafana reaches
# Prometheus and Alertmanager through the hub's loopback (decision #24). editable: false keeps the
# browser from changing them, so this file stays the record.
apiVersion: 1

datasources:
  - name: Prometheus
    type: prometheus
    uid: prometheus
    access: proxy
    url: "http://127.0.0.1:9090"
    isDefault: true
    editable: false

  - name: Loki
    type: loki
    uid: loki
    access: proxy
    url: "http://127.0.0.1:3100"
    editable: false

  - name: Alertmanager
    type: alertmanager
    uid: alertmanager
    access: proxy
    url: "http://127.0.0.1:9093"
    basicAuth: true
    basicAuthUser: prometheus
    jsonData:
      implementation: prometheus
      handleGrafanaManagedAlerts: false
    secureJsonData:
      basicAuthPassword: "fixture-password-3"
    editable: false

  - name: Infinity
    type: yesoreyeram-infinity-datasource
    uid: infinity
    editable: false

  - name: GitHub
    type: grafana-github-datasource
    uid: github
    jsonData:
      selectedAuthType: github-app
      appId: "fixture-app_id-6"
      installationId: "fixture-installation_id-6"
    secureJsonData:
      privateKey: "fixture-private_key-6"
    editable: false
roles/hub/templates/ntfy-server.yml.j2:
# Managed by Ansible (roles/hub). Edits here are overwritten.
base-url: "https://ntfy.tail4cf2f3.ts.net"

behind-proxy: true
cache-file: "/var/lib/ntfy/cache.db"

  - "alertmanager:pages:wo"
